title: 第七章击杀龙家长老第八章龙野陨落秦风遁走
content_zh:
拳落，秦风也不犹豫，立马施展出了在龙家所学的大功法《游龙》，以残影般的速度，朝着龙府外离去。
他知道，这是出其不备离开的最好机会！！！
然而，他却没想到，龙战早就安排了龙家强者在后山外面等候，就是怕到时候秦风交出神龙真元而出现意外。
当看见秦风施展功法游龙出来时，龙家长老龙昌如临大敌道：“秦风，刚才那一声惨叫是怎么回事？怎么就你一人出来？？”
“给老夫止步！！”
“喝！！”
话落，龙昌一掌拍出，身上灵气纵横，通天之威暴漏无疑。
就在此时，一道愤怒的声音从后山震耳欲聋道：“秦风！！竟敢偷袭吾儿，我龙战，要让你生不如死！！”
“所有龙家之人听令，拦住秦风，别让他离开龙家！！”
“给老子等死吧！！”
刹那间，磅礴的登天之威爆涌肆虐。
秦风能够感受得到身后所传来的恐怖杀意！！！
还有一一股股追击而来的龙家高层！！！
“该死，得再快点才行！！”
“给我滚开！！”
秦风不敢犹豫，面对龙昌的掌威，他在一次施展龙象镇天拳！！
砰！！
拳掌碰撞，顿时爆发出了害人波动。
龙昌感受到秦风所施展的拳威之强时，脸色骤变道：“怎么可能？这家伙的龙象镇天拳之威，居然比老夫的还要恐怖！！”
“该死！！”

话音刚落，恐怖拳威已然落在了龙昌胸前，将其震飞了出去。
“噗！”
一口老血从嘴里喷出，龙昌只感觉五脏六腑都已破碎。
但还来不及多想，秦风贴身靠近，然后又是一拳道：“对不住了，龙昌长老，我，还不想死在龙家！！”
“要怪，就怪你们龙家太不把我秦风当回事了。”
“哼！”
就在龙昌想要反抗时，重重的拳威之力，再次落在了胸膛之出，让他这位龙家长老一命呜呼，胸前凹陷进去，面目无比狰狞！！
只是他瞳孔收缩，久久未散，似乎不敢相信，他这位通天境后期长老，居然会死在秦风手里......
由于龙昌阻拦，导致龙家族人蜂拥而至。
哪怕秦风的游龙功法已经修炼到了大成，但依旧无法逃离后山，而是众多龙家年轻一辈给围了起来。
当这些龙家年轻一辈，看见龙昌倒在一旁的尸体时，一个个都傻眼了。
似乎不敢相信，秦风居然会击杀龙家长老，而且还是境界比他高的龙昌！！
“秦风，你这是做什么？？”
content_en:
As soon as the punch fell, Qin Feng did not hesitate, and immediately performed the great skill "Wandering Dragon" he learned in the Long Family, and left outside the Long Mansion at the speed of an afterimage.
He knew that this was the best opportunity to leave unprepared! ! !
However, he did not expect that Long Zhan had already arranged for the strong men of the Long family to wait outside the back mountain, just because he was afraid that something unexpected would happen when Qin Feng handed over the dragon's true essence.
When he saw Qin Feng using his skills to swim the dragon out, Long Chang, the elder of the Dragon family, faced the enemy and said: "Qin Feng, what was that scream just now? Why are you the only one coming out??"
"Stop it, I am!!"
"Drink!!"
After finishing his words, Long Chang struck out with a palm, his body full of spiritual energy, and his power to the sky was undoubtedly revealed.
At this moment, an angry voice came from the back mountain and said deafeningly: "Qin Feng!! How dare you sneak attack my son, I, Long Zhan, will make your life worse than death!!"
"All the people of the Long family listen to the order and stop Qin Feng and don't let him leave the Long family!!"
"Just wait for me to die!!"
In an instant, the majestic power of ascending to the sky exploded and raged.
Qin Feng could feel the terrifying killing intent coming from behind him! ! !
There are also senior officials of the Long family who are chasing after them one after another! ! !
"Damn it, we have to hurry up!!"
"Get out of my way!!"
Qin Feng did not dare to hesitate. Facing Long Chang's power, he used the Dragon Elephant Sky-Suppressing Fist at once! !
Bang! !
The fists collided, and a harmful wave suddenly erupted.
When Long Chang felt the power of Qin Feng's fist, his expression suddenly changed: "How is it possible? The power of this guy's Dragon Elephant Sky-Suppressing Fist is actually more terrifying than my own!!"
"Damn!!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the terrifying punch landed on Long Chang's chest, knocking him away.
"Poof!"
A mouthful of old blood spurted out from his mouth, and Long Chang felt that his internal organs had been shattered.
But before he had time to think about it, Qin Feng got close and punched him again: "I'm sorry, Elder Longchang, I don't want to die in the Long family yet!!"
"If I'm to blame, it's your Long family's fault for not taking me, Qin Feng, seriously."
"Hmph!"
Just when Long Chang wanted to resist, a heavy punch landed on his chest again, killing him, the elder of the Long family, with his chest sunken in and his face extremely ferocious! !
It's just that his pupils shrank and stayed there for a long time, as if he couldn't believe that he, an elder in the late Tongtian realm, would actually die in Qin Feng's hands...
Due to Long Chang's obstruction, the Long family members swarmed in.
Even though Qin Feng's Wandering Dragon Technique has reached great perfection, he still cannot escape from the back mountain, but is surrounded by many younger generations of the Long family.
When these younger generations of the Long family saw Long Chang's body lying aside, they were all dumbfounded.
It seemed that he couldn't believe that Qin Feng would actually kill the elder Long Chang, and it was Long Chang who was at a higher level than him! !
"Qin Feng, what are you doing??"
